nvitk.io.conversors._poly_stencil¶

VTK helpers: STL → voxel grid, multilabel merge, and NIfTI export for nvitk.io.conversors.stl2nifti.

Functions¶

read_stl(stl_path)

Read an STL mesh file into a VTK STL reader (already updated).

read_nifti(nifti_path)

Read a NIfTI volume into a VTK NIfTI image reader (already updated).

write_nifti(→ None)

Write a VTK image to NIfTI, setting the qform/sform matrix and q-factor for correct orientation.

stl_to_vtk_binary(stl_path, reference_nifti_path[, ...])

Rasterize an STL surface into a binary vtkImageData aligned to a reference NIfTI.

stl_to_numpy_binary(→ Tuple[numpy.ndarray, Dict])

Rasterize an STL mesh to a binary uint16 label array matched to a reference NIfTI's geometry.

multilabel_from_stls(stl_paths, reference_nifti_path)

Create a multi-label vtkImageData from a collection of STL files.

list_stl_files(→ List[pathlib.Path])

Sorted list of .stl files under input_path (a single file, or every STL in a directory).
